B_own_size.form: A ruling whose `governs` names every component meta, so the reader's Q1 join (governs[] naming the meta path, read LIVE) puts it in the `governs` of every seed, for every part. Plus the size check (Run 4 lane 4c) as its instrument — advisory until Dave promotes it.
B_own_size.wording_proposed: A part keeps its own size on any page. The page arranges parts; it never shrinks them. (R6a's draft wording, shown to Dave on question 5.)

C_lightest_pattern.dave: and question the choice of using a model when and a split button or drop-down would be better.
C_lightest_pattern.form: A ruling governing modals, split-button and dropdown, plus the four `when` rows marked observation C in when-rules.proposed.json. The `yields to` sentences in modals' prose half are what the yieldsTo derivation reads (meta.schema.json edges.yieldsTo: DERIVED from the prose half), so the edges below are the derivation's expected output, listed for review, not hand-written.
C_lightest_pattern.cross_role_note: modals provides `overlay`, split-button `action`, dropdown `input`: three roles, so the chooser never ranks them against each other inside one role. The hand-off is the yield edge plus the `interrupts` field — a brief that says the choice can be made in place rules the modal out.
C_lightest_pattern.wording_proposed: Use the lightest pattern that does the job. Before a modal, ask whether a split button or a drop-down would do. (R6a's draft wording, question 6.)
